Fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top, light grey high-waisted yoga leggings with one leg rolled up to the knee, fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible on the hand rolling the legging. Warm yellow-white living room light. Mood: the fourth summon, the patience snapped, two requests at once. Text watermark 'P14-PN06' in the bottom-right corner.
